pre_execution_red_team_amendment.change: Bind v77 coefficients to their sealed formal U8 basis before forming the inherited physical correction. Map that physical correction, never the coordinate vector, into the independently rebuilt GSLB32 basis. Also correct Stage 1 wording to Stage 2.

pre_execution_implementation_audit_amend.change: Require the independent validator to store and compare every one of the 21 declared start vectors against the formal start vector, with maximum absolute coefficient difference <=1e-9. Also require column-wise GSLB32 mode agreement <=1e-9 so coordinate-defined Gaussian starts retain the same physical meaning.

scientific_question: At the unchanged 2A+2A-transpose online budget, does the preregistered 32-mode prefix of the same geometry-only low-observability spline eigensystem contain a coefficient witness that, after one unchanged exact CGLS step, satisfies every frozen field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation gate in all 75 already-open Case 3 development cells?
evidence_role: Post-open representation-capacity diagnostic on the same already-open BLASTNet vitiated H2-air Case 3 cells. Truth may choose coefficients only inside the fixed GSLB32 space after this protocol is frozen. This is not a deployable predictor, independent external validation, runtime result, neural-operator result, curved-ray result, real-BOST result, algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.

parent_v77.private_parent_release_role: A local, non-published release frozen before v78 execution binds the independently validated v77 formal_result.json, rows.jsonl, geometry_modes.npy, READY.json, independent_validation.json, and VALIDATED_READY.json by byte count and SHA-256. The release contains no v78 result and is verified unchanged by both v78 programs.

fixed_open_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: inherit v75 full-bounding-box xyz-to-zyx interpolation, one-cell zero support boundary, and supported-interior zero-mean gauge without amplitude normalization
fixed_open_data_and_geometry.stable_cell_identity: scenario_id plus integer frame_index; search seeds depend only on the frozen start roster and never on traversal order

representation.parent_space: Exactly the v77 supported zero-gauge 8x4x4 trilinear spline lattice with effective rank 127.
representation.ordering: Exactly the single v77 geometry-only generalized eigensystem C_g v = lambda G v, ascending by exact-observation energy per regularized interior-gradient energy.
representation.nested_prefix_rule: U_g,32 must be the first 32 columns of the same once-computed 127-mode eigensystem used by v77. Its first eight columns must reproduce the independently validated GSLB8 subspace under the frozen stable projector comparison; signed or rotated coordinate coefficients may never be assumed identical across independently rebuilt bases.
representation.cutoff_rule: The preregistered relative eigengap after mode 32 must be strictly positive under the unchanged v77 rule. Otherwise stop INCONCLUSIVE before truth-aware search.

online_mechanism_and_exact_cost.cheap_dual: z = four-step detector CR using the frozen loaded rank-8 separable factor and observation y
online_mechanism_and_exact_cost.strict_breakdown_rule: exactly as frozen v66 warm_cgls: require <s0,s0> > 1e-30 and <t0,t0> > 1e-30 before alpha; otherwise x1, r1, alpha, all gates, and all candidate Jacobians are undefined and that optimizer evaluation is INVALID_CGLS_BREAKDOWN, never clipped, regularized, replaced by x0, or assigned a fabricated finite gate

geometry_setup_accounting.formal_execution_mode: cold rebuild from the frozen geometry; the runner may not load or reuse v77 geometry modes

truth_aware_oracle.truth_may_choose: One 32-dimensional coefficient vector in the fixed GSLB32 space for each already-open development cell.
truth_aware_oracle.coefficient_energy: because selected modes are G-orthonormal, ||a||2 is the regularized interior-gradient energy norm of the correction
truth_aware_oracle.anchor_energy: E_h = ||L_I h||2^2 + epsilon*||M h||2^2, using exactly the frozen L_I, M, spacing, support, and geometry-specific epsilon above
truth_aware_oracle.coefficient_radius: ||a||2 <= 2*max(sqrt(E_h),1e-12); h and this radius are deployment-visible
truth_aware_oracle.optimizer: float64 SLSQP epigraph minimax with exact analytic gate Jacobians and exact Euclidean-ball Jacobian
truth_aware_oracle.optimizer_implementation: scipy.optimize.minimize(method='SLSQP') with variables [a_0,...,a_31,t], objective t, objective Jacobian [0,...,0,1], constraints t-g_j(a)>=0 for all eight gates and radius^2-a^T a>=0, no variable bounds, options maxiter=1000 ftol=1e-12 disp=false
truth_aware_oracle.single_restart_rule: if and only if the primary SLSQP reports success=false or status!=0, its raw endpoint passes the frozen finite and coefficient-ball endpoint certification, direct CGLS and all eight gates are finite, and that certified endpoint is not already a positive direct witness, run exactly one second SLSQP with all settings unchanged and initial [a_cert,max_j g_j(a_cert)]; never restart a successful primary, a breakdown/non-finite/far-ball endpoint, or an already positive witness
truth_aware_oracle.terminal_epigraph_feasibility_rule: for any status-0 attempt used to complete a negative search require min_j(t_raw-g_j(a_raw))>=-1e-10 and t_raw-max_j(g_j(a_cert))>=-1e-10, with all values directly recomputed in float64; finite-but-infeasible constraints are incomplete and cannot authorize a negative conclusion
truth_aware_oracle.metric_scales: scale_field=||truth||2; scale_full_gradient=||L truth||2; scale_interior_gradient=||L_I truth||2; scale_observation=||y||2, using the uniquely defined L and L_I above; require every scale >=1e-12 exactly as v75
truth_aware_oracle.gate_normalization: for each m in field,full-gradient,interior-gradient,observation let f_m=1e-12*max(scale_m,1e-30); allowed harm error tau_h=1.01*(E_zeroK4_m+f_m)-f_m and allowed equal-call error tau_e=1.00*(E_zeroK2_m+f_m)-f_m; define g_h(a)=E_candidate_m(a)^2/max(tau_h^2,1e-30)-1 and g_e(a)=E_candidate_m(a)^2/max(tau_e^2,1e-30)-1; the epigraph contains these eight gates in that metric order with harm before equal-call
truth_aware_oracle.epigraph_start: for every coefficient start a0, t0=max_j g_j(a0)
truth_aware_oracle.least_squares_start_definition: field, full-gradient, and interior-gradient starts minimize respectively ||U32 a-(truth-h)||2, ||L U32 a-L(truth-h)||2, and ||L_I U32 a-L_I(truth-h)||2 using np.linalg.lstsq(...,rcond=1e-12); each is then radially projected once onto the Euclidean coefficient ball if needed using the frozen radial projection rule
truth_aware_oracle.radial_projection_rule: for finite a with norm r, if r>radius replace a once by a*np.nextafter(radius/r,0.0); require the resulting norm <= radius; a non-finite norm is INCONCLUSIVE
truth_aware_oracle.gaussian_start_definition: for each frozen seed s use np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(s)).standard_normal(32), require a finite nonzero Euclidean norm, normalize once by that norm, multiply by the declared radius fraction and coefficient radius, then apply the frozen radial projection rule
truth_aware_oracle.nested_parent_start: For each cell, read the validated v77 best eight coefficients a8_formal and the paired sealed formal field basis U8_formal from the same verified private parent release; form the physical correction u8=U8_formal*a8_formal. Independently rebuild U8_independent and U32_independent from the frozen geometry, require the stable projector distance between U8_formal and U8_independent <=1e-9, map u8 into U32_independent coordinates using np.linalg.lstsq(U32_independent,u8,rcond=1e-12), require ||U32_independent*a32-u8||2/max(||u8||2,1e-30)<=1e-9, apply no radial rescaling unless the mapped norm exceeds the unchanged radius only by at most the frozen 1e-10 endpoint tolerance, require the resulting candidate field and all eight gates to match direct replay of the sealed v77 physical correction within 1e-9, and include this vector once as inherited_v77_best. A formal coordinate vector is never multiplied by an independently rebuilt basis, no signed coefficient identity is assumed, and no other v77 result may alter the search.
truth_aware_oracle.passing_witness_rule: at least one finite coefficient vector must directly satisfy all eight frozen absolute gates with maximum normalized quadratic gate <= -1e-8
truth_aware_oracle.negative_completion_rule: If no positive witness exists, all 21 declared starts must satisfy the unchanged v77 terminal completion contract, including any conditionally triggered same-settings restart. Otherwise the cell and stage are INCONCLUSIVE.
truth_aware_oracle.monotonicity_requirement: Every v77 positive cell must remain a direct positive witness through the inherited nested start. If not, stop INCONCLUSIVE_NESTED_PREFIX_OR_PARENT_REPLAY_DRIFT.
truth_aware_oracle.coefficient_ball_endpoint_certification: for a raw SLSQP endpoint a_raw compute excess=max(0,||a_raw||2/radius-1); radius is at least 2e-12. If excess<=1e-10, define a_cert=a_raw when ||a_raw||2<=radius, otherwise a_cert=a_raw*np.nextafter(radius/||a_raw||2,0.0), a single float64 radial scaling directed toward the ball interior. Require ||a_cert||2<=radius after scaling. If excess>1e-10, certification still exceeds the ball, or any value is non-finite, the endpoint is not a candidate and that start cannot satisfy the negative completion rule.
truth_aware_oracle.direct_witness_certification: only a finite start already inside the ball or a_cert from the frozen endpoint certification may enter best_coefficients or become a positive witness; all eight gates and CGLS validity are directly recomputed on that exact certified vector
truth_aware_oracle.optimizer_breakdown_handling: if SLSQP requests an INVALID_CGLS_BREAKDOWN point, terminate that start as failed without returning a synthetic objective, gate, or Jacobian; if no other start produces a positive direct witness, the cell and Stage 2 are INCONCLUSIVE rather than negative
truth_aware_oracle.optimizer_failure_interpretation: if no positive direct witness exists and any declared start fails the optimizer completion rule or requests an INVALID_CGLS_BREAKDOWN evaluation, the cell and Stage 2 are INCONCLUSIVE

decision.if_pass: Authorize only a separately frozen observation-only 32-coefficient predictor protocol on Case 3 development folds. Do not open Case 4 or Case 6 and do not claim deployment.
decision.if_fail: Authorize only the preregistered GSLB127 final parent-space ceiling after independent validation. Do not train a neural rescue.
decision.if_inconclusive: Repair only the identified numerical or validation defect without changing data, representation, rank, radius, starts, optimizer, gates, controls, or calls.
